board.about: Bootstrap variant: a bootstrap board administers only the first election and carries the persistent replacement warning until the seated legislature appoints a proper board (WF-ELE-10).
board.bootstrap_body: This board exists only to run the first election. The seated legislature must appoint a proper, politically neutral board as part of its first sessions.
board.bootstrap_title: Bootstrap election board — temporary · replacement queued.
board.cause_required: cause must be stated on the order
board.cert_cite: available to R-08 · prereq: voting closed + tabulation complete · Art. II §2 (transparent election process)
board.cert_empty: Nothing awaiting certification. Counts appear here the moment a ranked window closes.
board.cite_establish: Establish independent election boards · Art. II §2
board.cutoff_hint: X per race is pre-published with this order · CLK-21
board.cutoff_hint_sel: X per race is pre-published with this order — {races} · CLK-21
board.district_cite: available to R-08 · prereq: legislature seat count above 9 · Art. II §2; Art. II §8 (Subdivision)
board.district_empty: No district maps under oversight. Chambers at or below the 9-seat ceiling run at-large by constitutional default (Art. II §8).
board.emergency_body: An emergency cannot suspend an election or the board work. Certification, seating and the countback run on their clocks regardless.
board.emergency_title: Elections cannot be disrupted — the board proceeds.
board.intro: The board is an independent, politically neutral office. It schedules, validates, oversees boundaries, certifies, audits, and orders recounts. It never counts by hand. Tabulation runs in protected code.
board.no_board: No election board is standing for you. This console is readable by everyone. Its actions belong to seated board members (R-08).
board.queue_body: Residency association is the only permissible check. A rejection is appealable in court.
board.queue_cite: available to R-08 · prereq: F-IND-011 submitted · Art. II §2 (election integrity)
board.ranked_closes_hint: Entered and stored as UTC. The engine validates window ordering and phase lengths.
board.recount_cause_hint: The engine rejects an order without a stated cause.
board.sig_cite: available to R-08 · prereq: petition at threshold · Art. II §6 (independent audit)
board.vac_cite: Vacancy declaration received · F-LEG-036 · countback per Art. II §5
board.vac_empty: No vacancies. Every seat in the jurisdiction is held.
board.viewing: You are viewing this board. Its actions belong to seated board members (R-08).
candidacy.about_after: (rejected / withdrawn / non-finalist are terminal public-record branches). The board’s only check is residency (F-ELB-002).
candidacy.about_before: WF-CIV-05 candidacy lifecycle. Entity machine ESM-06:
candidacy.attest: I attest that I reside in the selected jurisdiction.
candidacy.attest_strong: Nothing else is asked of me.
candidacy.cite_right: Right to stand — Art. I · no fees, no signatures, no vetting
candidacy.closes_note: closes at the finalist cutoff · reopens at certification · CLK-18
candidacy.establish_body: Voting and candidacy unlock together the moment residency verifies — no other requirement exists, by constitutional design.
candidacy.establish_cite: Residency verified → all associations → rights unlocked · Art. I; Art. V §1
candidacy.establish_title: Establish residency to stand for office
candidacy.intro: If you live somewhere, you can run for office there — that’s the only requirement. Sign-ups stay open the whole time between elections: they open the moment the last election is certified and close only when the final ballot locks (the finalist cutoff).
candidacy.next_1_before: The election board validates your residency association —
candidacy.next_1_strong: the only check that may exist
candidacy.next_2: You enter the approval pool: every associated resident can approve you, revocably, until the finalist cutoff (WF-CIV-08 · CLK-18).
candidacy.next_3: The top X by approvals advance to the ranked ballot; everyone else remains write-in eligible — the right to stand is never lost (CLK-21).
candidacy.next_cite: finalists X = finalist_multiplier × seats · pre-published with the scheduling order · CLK-21
candidacy.no_offices: No race footprint of this election contains one of your associations — this election may simply not be yours to stand in.
candidacy.office_hint: Only jurisdictions you are associated with are listed — candidacy follows residency, nothing else.
candidacy.platform_hint: Public, self-managed, editable any time via F-CAN-001.
candidacy.pool_title: Validated — you are in the approval pool.
candidacy.registered_body: The board’s validation (F-ELB-002) checks residency and nothing else — it is the only check that may exist.
candidacy.registered_cite: Art. I · residency is the only check
candidacy.rejected_appendonly: — the rejection itself is on the audit chain (append-only).
candidacy.rejected_pool_before: The only permissible ground for rejection is the absence of a residency association in the selected jurisdiction — anything else would violate Art. I. If you believe this is wrong, correct your residency declaration or
candidacy.rejected_pool_title: Registration rejected — no residency association found.
candidacy.rejected_title: Filing rejected by the constitutional engine
candidacy.see_standing: See your standing on the open ballot
candidacy.withdrawn_body: Withdrawal is a permanent public record.
countback.about_devseed: Phase B vacancies are dev-seeded (php artisan vacancy:declare). The F-LEG-036 declaration form itself arrives with Phase C Speaker tooling.
countback.about_machine: Entity state machine: Vacancy. The strip above tracks the live record.
countback.catalog_alias: catalog alias: F-LEG-030 · workflows catalog (renumbering drift)
countback.cert_cite: available to R-08 Election Board Member · Art. II §2 (transparent election process)
countback.cite_method: Vacancies filled by countback of prior ballots · Art. II §5 · countback engine — hardened
countback.declare_body: Declare a seat vacant due to death, resignation, removal, or incapacity.
countback.declare_cite: available to R-09 Legislative Representative / R-10 Speaker · creates a vacancy record → triggers countback · Art. II §5
countback.declared_by: Declared by {who} on {when} — shown in your timezone, stored as UTC.
countback.exhausted_body: No continuing candidate can reach the quota. The countback fails and a special election must be held no sooner than {min} and no later than {max} days after the vacancy.
countback.found_body: The countback yields a replacement. The election board certifies, the winner is seated by oath (F-LEG-001), and committee proportionality is re-checked.
countback.gold_tick: Gold tick = the Droop quota. A continuing candidate who reaches it fills the seat. Ballots with no remaining preference become exhausted.
countback.intro: No new election is needed yet. The game re-runs the prior election ballots with the vacated member removed as a candidate (a vacancy countback). The voters' original preferences decide the replacement. Only if those ballots run out does a special election follow.
countback.opens_forms: Opens WF-ELE-04 · forms F-ELB-001, F-IND-011, F-IND-007, F-ELB-004
countback.prop_pending_cite: re-check runs when the replacement is seated · WF-LEG-13 · Art. II §4
countback.prop_recheck: Committee proportionality re-checked after seating · WF-LEG-13
countback.rerun_cite: Re-run of prior ballots with the vacated member removed · Art. II §5 · universal — no faction filtering · STV with Droop quota — hardened
countback.rerun_source_body: The engine strikes the vacated member and continues the count from the voters' next preferences. The re-run is universal — every prior ballot counts, with no faction filtering anywhere in the procedure.
countback.rerun_source_lead: Re-run source: the prior {label} — {total} valid ballots, {seats} {seatWord}, Droop quota
countback.running_body: The countback is re-running the stored ballots. This page refreshes itself until the record lands.
countback.scheduling_gated: Scheduling opens only if the countback exhausts.
countback.special_date_hint: Window for this vacancy: {opens} to {closes} (latest start {latest} — the {days}-day ranked window must fit inside). The engine rejects dates outside the window.
countback.special_scheduled: Special election scheduled — ranked window opens {when} (status: {status}). The order below refines dates within the window.
countback.special_window: Special election window · {min}–{max} days · CLK-04 · Art. II §5
countback.term_inherit_cite: a replacement term never outlives the term it fills. The inherited ends_on is written once and never moves · Art. II §5
countback.title: Vacancy countback — {office}
map.boundary_unavailable: The boundary outline is unavailable for this place.
map.tiles_unavailable: Geographic map tiles are unavailable. The boundary outline can still be viewed.
open.about: Approval counts and ranks update daily and freeze at the finalist cutoff. Individual approvals remain secret. You can search every candidate in this race without loading the whole ballot at once.
open.announce_approved: Approved. Revocable until the finalist cutoff.
open.browse_only: You can browse this race. Approving requires a residency association here.
open.filter_label: Search the entire race — ranks always reflect the full race
open.interrupted: The request was interrupted. Refresh this page to confirm your saved approvals.
open.intro: Approve the candidates you trust. You can change your mind until the phase closes. The top finalists then go on the ranked ballot, where write-ins stay open.
open.no_candidates: No validated candidates yet. Any associated resident can stand.
open.no_match_page: No candidates on this page match your search.
open.no_races_body: The election board has not finished preparing this election's races.
open.nudge: First time voting here? Explore how the election works.
open.page_count: {n} candidates on this page. Search and page through the entire race.
open.secret_body: Public counts update daily. Your approval appears immediately in your switch and personal total. It does not change the public count until the next update.
open.show_first_all: Show first page of all candidates
open.stand_body: Any associated resident may register. Registration stays open until the finalist cutoff.
open.stat_my_approvals: your active approvals across this race
open.title: Open ballot
open.toggle_hint: Toggle a candidate's switch to save or withdraw your approval.
ranked.about: Interaction note: ranking is click-to-rank with up and down keys, keyboard operable, no drag required.
ranked.announce_committed: Ballot committed — copy your receipt now; it is shown once.
ranked.check_not_found: Not found — check for typos; hashes are 64 characters.
ranked.check_unreachable: Could not reach the receipt check — try again.
ranked.cite_form: Ballot submission (ranked choice) · F-IND-007 · available to R-04 Voter · Art. II §2
ranked.cite_stv: STV with Droop quota · hardened · Art. II §2
ranked.closed_approval: The approval phase is still under way. Finalists lock at the cutoff, then the ranked window opens.
ranked.closed_title: The ranked window is not open.
ranked.closed_voting: Voting has closed for this race.
ranked.commit_body: Committing encrypts your ballot and separates it cryptographically from your identity. You will receive a receipt hash for self-audit. Nobody can connect it back to you.
ranked.commit_cite: Cryptographic separation of voter identity from ballot · Art. II §2 · Ensure Election Security and Integrity
ranked.committed_body: Keep your receipt hash to verify your ballot was tabulated. The lookup is anonymized.
ranked.custody_cite: Public chain of custody — endorsing organizations and candidates can observe and audit the count · Art. II §2
ranked.finalists_cite: top {n} from the approval phase · CLK-21
ranked.guidance_full: All seats covered — extra ranks only help your vote transfer further. Nothing is saved until you commit; closing this tab loses the draft.
ranked.guidance_more: Rank for all {seats} seats (or more) so your vote can transfer — {more} more recommended. Nothing is saved until you commit; closing this tab loses the draft.
ranked.how_body: Instant multi-winner PR-STV with the Droop quota: every candidate reaching the quota is elected, surpluses transfer at fractional value (Gregory method), and all seats fill in one count.
ranked.how_gloss: Droop quota is the smallest vote total that only the seated candidates can all reach: floor(votes / (seats + 1)) + 1.
ranked.intro: Rank as many candidates as you like. Ranking for all seats keeps your vote alive as the count unfolds. Your ballot is secret. Your receipt code lets you check it was counted.
ranked.live_agg_note: {ballots} ballots so far · Droop quota if closed now: {quota}
ranked.live_body: Standings stay visible through the ranked window: first preferences counted so far, as if the window closed this minute.
ranked.live_title: Live aggregate — if the window closed now
ranked.machine_note: Ballot machine: {machine} — the receipt hash is your handle on the counted state.
ranked.no_match: No validated candidates match your search.
ranked.proj_before: Projection only — surpluses and eliminations transfer at the close · full count on the
ranked.ref_cite: Referendum vote · F-IND-008 · available to R-04 Voter · Art. II §6
ranked.ref_delegated: Delegated by supermajority act · F-LEG-023 · passes at the threshold matching the act type · Art. II §6
ranked.ref_phase_c: Referendum content arrives with Phase C.
ranked.title: Ranked ballot — {race}
ranked.verify_hint: Anonymized lookup. Anyone may check any hash against the public count record.
ranked.voted_body: Your ballot is in the count. Your receipt hash was shown once at commit. It cannot be re-issued by you or by anyone.
ranked.voted_title: Your ballot is in the count
ranked.window_closed: The ranked window has closed. The engine will reject this ballot (Art. II §2).
ranked.window_closes: Window closes {when} · shown in your timezone · stored as UTC
ranked.writein_body: Any validated candidate may be written in, finalist or not. {n} validated non-finalists remain write-in eligible in this race.
ranked.writein_cite: Your right to stand and to vote for anyone is preserved · Art. II §2
ranked.writein_hint: Search by name. Write-ins are search-driven, never enumerated.
results.about: Entity state machine: Election — Tabulating to Certified (to Recount). The countback engine (WF-ELE-03) re-runs these same ballots when a vacancy opens.
results.audit_gloss: A recount is an audit re-run of the stored ballots through the same protected engine. There is no hand count. Identical inputs reproduce an identical record hash.
results.cert_body: The count ran under a public chain of custody. Observation and audit standing belongs to the endorsing organizations and to the candidates themselves. Any voter can verify their own ballot by receipt hash.
results.cert_done: Certified {when} · F-ELB-004 · Election Results Certification · Art. II §2
results.cert_observe_cite: All factions can observe and audit · Art. II §2 · as implemented — observer standing transfers to endorsing organizations and candidates
results.cert_pending: Certification pending · F-ELB-004 · Election Results Certification · available to R-08 · Art. II §2
results.cite_method: STV with Droop quota · fractional (Gregory) surplus transfers · hardened · Art. II §2
results.cite_writein: Write-in of any validated candidate always allowed · Art. II §2
results.count_gloss: Gold tick = the Droop quota. Reaching it elects a candidate; their surplus transfers onward at fractional value so no vote is wasted.
results.intro: Every seat fills in this single count. Your vote moves to your next choice when your favorite either wins with room to spare or is eliminated, so no vote is wasted. Write-ins are counted exactly like finalists, and the full record below is public and auditable.
results.mid_label: Rounds {a}–{b} — expand any round for its vote transfers
results.rcv_body: Single-winner ranked-choice voting applies only to the individual executive office model. The top 4 runners-up become the executive advisors and alternates automatically, derived by sequential exclusion.
results.rcv_cite: Single-winner RCV only for the individual executive · top-4 runners-up as advisors · Art. III §3
results.recount_cause_hint: The engine rejects an order without a stated cause.
results.recount_gloss: The count runs in-system, so a recount is an audit review. Tabulation re-runs and the chain of custody is re-verified. There is no hand count.
results.stat_seats: seats — all filled in one count
results.tab_none_body: Tabulation dispatches automatically when the ranked window closes. No official can start, stop, or skip it.
results.tab_none_title: No count record exists for this race yet.
results.tab_running_body: The ranked window has closed and the protected counting engine is re-running every ballot. This page refreshes itself until the record lands.
results.title: Results — {race}
results.write_in_note_one: {names} entered as a write-in and was tabulated identically — transfers flow onward like any other.
results.write_in_note_other: {names} entered as write-ins and were tabulated identically — transfers flow onward like any other.
